_comment: CM agent pending Discord access list (owned by agents/cm.md). On guildMemberAdd in the AP guild, the bot matches the joining member's Discord user ID against `pending` and auto-assigns the listed role IDs, then posts a confirmation to #board and removes the entry (so a later rejoin does not silently re-grant). People without a known Discord ID yet go in `pending_no_id` as a human note — move them into `pending` keyed by ID once they have one.
